gate: H1b-1b Maynard Lemma 8.2 and GGPY/HR multiplier recovery
scope: An exact project proof makes Maynard Lemma 8.2 explicit for the H1b-1a cutoff. At kappa=1, partial summation transfers a future corrected absolute GGPY Lemma 3 error into Lemma 4 with factor 2. H1b-1b-2a closes the traced actual nonexcluded local factors and canonical-W_i base bound, while application excluded-modulus overheads remain open. Kuperberg gives a modern structural HR reproduction but no numerical uniform multiplier or cutoff. This is not a numerical basic-summation package or theorem threshold certificate.

ggpy_kappa_1_transfer_contract.assumed_lemma_3_error: |E(u)| <= C3(A1,A2) (L+1) uniformly for 1<=u<=z; no c_gamma factor is assumed
ggpy_kappa_1_transfer_contract.relative_error_recovery: Conditional on a certified actual-call Lambda_app,j, H1b-1b-2a gives c_gamma_j>1/[3(1+log Lambda_app,j)], so the Maynard-style relative multiplier is at most 6 C3(A1,A2)(1+log Lambda_app,j). Every application overhead is not yet certified.
ggpy_kappa_1_transfer_contract.finite_range: exactly the common range on which the assumed Lemma 3 error holds
ggpy_kappa_1_transfer_contract.warning: The application-specific eta_app,j values, C3(A1,A2), its valid range, actual A1/A2/L bounds and corrected r-fold composition are not supplied. Setting an application overhead, O-constant or normalization loss to one is forbidden.

obligation_updates.reason: The H1b-1a cutoff yields the uniform explicit multiplier 89 for both parts of Maynard Lemma 8.2.

At kappa=1, a corrected absolute Lemma 3 multiplier C3 transfers to an absolute Lemma 4 error with safe factor 2. H1b-1b-2a closes local factors but the application excluded-modulus overheads, C3 and its finite range remain missing.

Kuperberg gives an accessible modern structural reproduction after HR Lemma 5.4, but its O constants, B_L, B_k and specialization are not numerical. Original HR proof pages remain inaccessible, so the blocker is now quantitative rather than source identity alone.
The complete displayed Lemma 8.2 error shape now has a project-certified uniform multiplier 89; later substitutions remain separate obligations.

remaining_blockers: certify every actual application excluded modulus and eta_app,j without silently setting overhead to zero
recover an explicit absolute C3(A1,A2) and common z range from the HR/Kuperberg proof chain without treating O-constants as one
instantiate Maynard Lemma 8.4 values A1, A2 and L
bound the Lemma 8.4 test-function norm and redo the r-fold accumulation with the additional 6*C3_abs*(1+log Lambda_app,max) normalization loss on one common range
complete Lemma 8.1(ii), H1c-1, moment formulas and every other root dependency before any X_cert calculation
